lines.text: Four angels hold back the winds, and another angel from the east has the seal of the living God.
144,000 were sealed from all the tribes of Israel, with 12,000 from each tribe named.
A countless multitude wears white robes, holds olive branches, and cries out salvation to God and the Lamb.
The angels worship God facedown, and an elder says the people in white came out of slavery in Egypt.
